comparison.objective: Pull, wipe, reseat, read, and finally reseat an engine dipstick; candidate extracts a terminal for reuse.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated long-part extraction/insertion, wiping contact, inspection, and reporting versus extraction-tool-mediated latch release and delicate withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Valid wipe/reseat/read sequence, correct report, and engine closed versus correct terminal removed with connector parts undamaged. Candidate criteria are missing.
comparison.reason: Shared pulling is generic; the dipstick task tests procedural measurement and reporting, not retention-feature release.
